faq.title:
Frequently asked

questions.
faq.contact: Not here? <link>Write to us</link> and we’ll help.

processing.q: How long does it take to process a video?
processing.a: Processing normally finishes in under 3 minutes. The time can vary with video length, quality and service load; you can track progress in your projects.

fileFormats.a: You can upload MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV files or import a supported link. The 9:16 and 16:9 export formats are available on every plan.

editCaptions.q: Can I edit the hook and captions?
editCaptions.a: Yes. In the editor you can change the hook text, correct captions and adjust their style before exporting.

afterCancel.q: What happens to my videos if I cancel my plan?
afterCancel.a: Your plan features remain available until the paid period ends. After that, your videos follow the storage period of your current plan; download anything you need before it expires.

publish.q: Does Clipealo publish to my networks for me?
publish.a: Yes. Connect your accounts and choose where each clip goes. Available channels and scheduling depend on your plan.
